item.title: Lint, simulate, test
item.description:
Three checks, in the order you reach for them.

Lint

tik lint processes/support-request.edn

The linter enforces what the kernel cannot:

  • The closed guard basis — only operators the declared :process/guard-vocab admits.
  • Graph sanity — every :after names a stage that exists, and no cycles.
  • Stratified negation — [:not [:stage-reached …]] may only name a stage in a strictly earlier stratum, which is what makes the fixpoint provably deterministic.
  • Facts over flags — a warning where a bare boolean stands in for information worth recording.
  • Prefix boundaries — an :artifact prefix that does not end at a path boundary matches more than its author expects.

With no argument it lints the store instead: open tickets missing descriptions, titles, or signatures.
